title: BC Friday Tips #86 Restart the VS Code Extension Host
summary: Restarting the VS Code AL extension host via Command Palette can resolve build failures without reloading the entire window, reducing developer interruptions when the AL extension appears stuck.
key_points: Run 'Developer: Restart Extension Host' from Command Palette (Ctrl+Shift+P) when AL builds fail
Restarts only the extension process, not the whole VS Code window
Resolves errors like 'The package could not be created' without full window reload

quotes.text: Try running Developer: Restart Extension Host from the Command Palette (Ctrl+Shift+P).
quotes.why_it_matters: Provides the exact command to resolve extension issues without window reload

quotes.text: This restarts the process that runs VS Code extensions, including the AL extension, while keeping the window open.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains why this approach is faster than reloading the entire VS Code window
